scope: thirty-sixth batch: the first layer of native bank-statement and GL document OCR — the document shapes and the deterministic balance-chain repairs

decision.asked: whether to host bank-statement and GL document-level OCR natively
decision.answer: yes, OCR is the core product artifact
plan: this batch: document shapes + balance-chain repairs (pure)
next: the column-source validators (amounts may only come from amount columns)
then: the deterministic readers (Excel/CSV/text, PDF text layer) into decoded pages
then: the model path (bank/GL prompts, engine document tiers, execution wiring, whole-page escalation)

live_source.source_compare_command: cowork-migration-baseline.py compare baseline-thirty-fifth-delivery.json baseline-thirty-sixth-delivery.json (before pinned at 40ae6777)
live_source.runtime_projection_compare_with_previous: unchanged (settings_unchanged true, observations_changed false; the endpoint configuration digest stays c5882f4b, 60 endpoints and both platform flags unchanged)

covers: a consistent chain and a carried-forward row are released untouched
a swapped pair is flipped and marked, and its direction follows the swap
an amount read short or on the wrong side is inferred inside the band and marked for review
an out-of-band misread, two filled sides, equal sides, a jumping carried-forward row, a missing opening and an unparsable value are refused instead of guessed
only the first break is reported, and the warnings name the page and every inferred row

the GL side corrects a wrong side, warns on a break, hides a movement behind a balance-less row, settles the first row from the printed footer, derives the opening balance and back-fills the closing balance
the deployed coercions: None to empty string, numbers and booleans to their printed text, an unknown direction cleared
the audit markers start clear and the document type literals are fixed
a null page and null entries still build, and provenance plus raw_row_data survive

checks.note: every field the repair may touch is compared on both sides, not only the returned reasons and warnings

checks.command: docker exec ... python -m unittest test_cowork_ocr_magnitude test_cowork_ocr_error_format
checks.note: the previous batch's checks still pass after their indentation was aligned with the package
the chain warnings are the same class as the existing sanity/parse wording and are not registered, matching the current tree

intentional_differences: the two repairers share one module because the deployed sources state they share one parse rule; the tolerances are renamed BANK_TOL/GL_TOL now that they sit together
the deployed audit-warning helper is public as bank_chain_warnings because a caller now produces the page warnings; behaviour is unchanged
the deployed GL diagnostics went to a logger; a pure module holds none, and the automatic correction stays visible through the row marker and the returned warnings
the deployed environment switch and the whole-page escalation belong to the model path and are not part of this layer
VatReportDocument and GenericTableDocument are not declared yet because nothing on this side accepts them
the previous batch's magnitude module and its regression file were re-indented to the package convention (whitespace only)
not_run: real files, model calls, the queue, cost or quota paths
the column-source validators, the deterministic readers and the model path, which are the next layers
DMS, frontend integration, deployment, external business results and user acceptance
